verdict.rationale: Zamzar documents dedicated converters for all five named formats (SVG, JPG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP) and lists 'Compression' as a feature. However, nothing shows per-conversion control over output quality, dimensions, or compression level for images, so only the format-coverage half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented image quality settings, resize/dimension controls, compression-level parameters tied to image conversion, API options for these controls, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, common image formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, SVG) convert with control over quality, size, and compression
